title: Zerium: A video editor with zero limits.
description: Zerium is a free, open-source video editor with GPU previews, flexible animation, and extensible plugins. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
intro: A video editor that lets you work freely, from slideshows to detailed motion graphics.
screenshotAlt: Zerium editing a logo animation, showing the preview, properties, multilayer timeline, and keyframe curve.
featureIntro: A workspace for turning your ideas into videos
timelineBody: Arrange layers and adjust motion with keyframes and curves. The timeline combines intuitive editing with advanced controls.
gpuBody: GPU rendering provides fast previews of the scene you're editing. Check the results as you adjust your work.
pluginBody: Add items and effects through plugins to set up an editing environment that fits your workflow.
sceneBody: Group a set of items into a reusable scene to avoid repeating the same work.

developmentBody: Updates may change the project format, and older projects may no longer open. Please avoid using Zerium for important projects.
footerLine: A video editor with zero limits.
